card.name: Moment and scenario nouns after prepositions
card.fires_on: Nouns meaning an occasion or situation, mainly "moment", "moments", "times" and "scenarios", right after "the", "in", "for a", "at" or "following".

modes.label: Moment(s) in time
modes.description: The word moment or moments, often after a preposition, in phrases like "for the moment" or "in moments of".
